question: What do the knowers of scripture call the light-natured state in the three abodes?
premises: The knowers of scripture call that light-natured state fiery.
This occurs when the three abodes are established.
In that condition only pure light remains.
inference: When the three abodes are established, the light-natured state is called fiery and only pure light remains.
plain_english: Those skilled in scripture call that light-natured state fiery. Here, when the three abodes are established, what remains is mere light.
